Katie Price’s Ex Lee Andrews Left Businessman Penniless ‘After Conning Him Out Of $200,000’

ByMF Jones September 17, 2026September 17, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:04
Instaread

A man who claims Lee Andrews scammed him out of $200,000 has spoken out about his experience and the way Katie Price’s ex expertly groomed him and milked him for all he was worth.

Pop Music

 Businessman Nicholas Fiaschetti (below), 40, says he met Lee at the Four Seasons Hotel on the Palm Jumeirah in 2024 – but wishes he ‘never had’.

Discover more
investing
Businessman
Apparel

He claims he was left penniless after  investing $200,000 (£149,240) into a business promoted by Lee, who promised him ‘double the money back plus 20 per cent of the shares’. It felt like a non-brainer!

Business Operations

Nicholas claims Lee used an elaborate scheme to con him; with many many others in on it and ‘so many people connected to him telling me I could trust him’.

Nicholas told The Sun: ‘Lee worked hard to earn my trust. He tapped into my belief system in God, he made me think we both had the same way of thinking, the same morals and values.

‘Our conversations went on for a long time before any talk of investing came up’.

Investing

He adds: ‘Lee would talk and talk at me and you just start to believe it. Looking back, it makes me think of a psychopath – someone who has learned to mimic. Someone who can pretend to be happy and cheerful, but really they don’t feel that at all.’

Investing

Lee sent him details of a Lloyd’s bank account with over $100m (£74.6m) deposited, and showed him photos of him ‘with a sheik holding a cheque for $150m (£111.9m)’, leading Nicholas to believe that he was ‘loaded’ and the real deal.

And so Nicholas gave Lee $200,000, and of course, the returns on the  investment never arrived, with Lee claiming the funds were being ‘held up.’

When Nicholas started chasing him up about the money, Lee got his dad Peter involved and had him pose as an international lawyer.

Nicholas says: ‘[His dad] came on claiming he was an international lawyer and was backing up Lee’s version of events saying that the funds were being held up. It was utter bulls**t.’

Nicholas has now set up a GoFundMe to try and rebuild his life after losing everything and claiming he had to sleep in his car ‘for months’. He’s also reported Lee to the FBI.

Well, say what you want about Lee Andrews – he certainly knows how to get money for nothing. Well, at least until recently. I guess it was always inevitable that the fraudster life was going to catch up with him and he’s actually currently still in Dubai jail because of other frauds he’s committed.

Even Katie Price finally realised he was full of sh1t and ditched him after discovering he had just £2.22 in his crypto wallet (he claimed he had £32 million).

Pop Music

Good luck on your fundraiser, Nicholas. I mean, there are probably a lot more worthy causes out there than reimbursing the guy who gave $200,000 to Lee Andrews, but I suppose that was before everyone and their mothers realised what a blatant bullsh1t artist the man was.
